blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Like magnetic poles repel each other, whereas unlike magnetic poles attract each other.
An electromagnet exhibits magnetic properties only when electric current flows through its coil wrapped around a soft iron core.
Electromagnetic induction is the phenomenon of producing an induced current in a circuit by varying the magnetic field linked with it.
An electric motor transforms electrical energy into mechanical energy, while an electric generator transforms mechanical energy into electrical energy.

Magnetic field is the region around a magnet where its magnetic force can be felt. Magnetic field lines:

items:
• Originate from North pole
  • End at South pole
  • Never intersect each other
  • Are crowded near the poles

blocks.content: Earth behaves like a giant magnet.

items:
• Geographic north is near magnetic south
  • Geographic south is near magnetic north This is the reason why a compass works.
Geographic north is near magnetic south
Geographic south is near magnetic north This is the reason why a compass works.

blocks.content: A magnetic compass is an instrument used to find directions. It works on the principle that a freely suspended magnet aligns itself in North-South direction.
Electromagnetism is the phenomenon where a magnetic field is produced due to electric current.
When current flows through a conductor, it behaves like a magnet.
An electromagnet is a temporary magnet produced by passing electric current through a coil wound around a soft iron core.

items:
• Strong magnetic field
  • Can be switched ON and OFF
  • Strength depends on current
Can be switched ON and OFF

blocks.content: DIFFERENCE BETWEEN PERMANENT MAGNET AND ELECTROMAGNET

items:
• Permanent magnetism
  • Cannot be switched off
  • Weak magnetic field

• Temporary magnet
  • Can be switched ON/OFF
  • Strong magnetic field

blocks.content: An electric motor converts electrical energy into mechanical energy. Principle:
A current carrying conductor placed in a magnetic field experiences a force.
Electromagnetic induction is the phenomenon of production of electric current when magnetic flux linked with a conductor changes.
An electric generator converts mechanical energy into electrical energy. It works on the principle of electromagnetic induction.

items: Soft iron is used as the core of electromagnets because of its high magnetic permeability and low retentivity.
Fleming's Left-Hand Rule applies to Electric Motors, while Fleming's Right-Hand Rule applies to Electric Generators.
Magnetic field lines form continuous closed loops, running from North to South outside the magnet and South to North inside it.
